text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly down, with BTC holding a dominant 56% market share while altcoins show minimal movement, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 29 indicates market participants remain cautious, though the 4-point weekly rise hints at a gradual thaw in sentiment. Volume at $47B is moderate, consistent with a pause in risk-taking rather than panic liquidation.
